title: Hindelangstraße, Munich
description:
Room with balcony!

The apartment has currently being completely renovated and offers state-of-the-art living comfort.

The property is located on quiet and highly sought-after Hindelangstraße in the Forstenried district of Munich, an ideal residential area for families and professionals. The neighborhood offers a pleasant mix of well-kept homes, green spaces, and a relaxed atmosphere. Shops for daily needs, restaurants, pharmacies, doctors, and other services are within walking distance. Kindergartens, schools, and leisure facilities are also nearby. Excellent bus and subway connections provide quick access to the city center, while the nearby Forstenrieder Park and surrounding green areas offer plenty of opportunities for recreation, sports, and walks. Overall, the location combines peaceful living with urban convenience and easy access to nature.

The kitchen, the guest-toilet and the bathroom are shared spaces.

If you're interested, please contact us in writing.
Please also tell us a little about yourself. Should a rental agreement be reached, each room will have its own independent lease.

It's important to us that the WG fits together, so feel free to let us know what makes you as a person.

title: Engadiner Straße, Munich
description:

title: Schaffhauser Straße, Munich
description:
The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-maintained building in a prime location. All essential shops and services are within walking distance, ensuring a high level of convenience. The apartment is available for immediate move-in.

Nearby, you’ll find beautiful green spaces such as Südpark and Forstenrieder Park, offering a variety of sports facilities (including football, tennis, and handball). The area also features numerous cafés, shopping opportunities, and childcare facilities, all within easy walking distance.

Public transportation is excellent, with the U-Bahn Line 3 (Fo... station) just a 5-minute walk away. This provides a direct connection to Marienplatz/city center in approximately 15 minutes, as well as easy access to the university area with just one transfer.

Apartment Features

This bright and spacious apartment offers 64 m2 of well-designed living space. The layout is practical and comfortable. The living room, bedroom, and hallway feature high-quality wooden floors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The bathroom and kitchen are equipped with modern tiling. 

Additional highlights include built-in ceiling lighting, which enhances the ambiance, and a west-facing loggia, perfect for enjoying sunsets. The kitchen is fully equipped, making it ideal for those who love to cook and entertain. The loggia is private for room 2, but can be shared after consultation.

title: Schaffhauser Straße, Munich
description:
Room Description
This cozy and modern private room offers a generous common area. The room is elegantly furnished with a comfortable bed, a large wardrobe, and a desk, providing ample space for both relaxation and productivity. Our shared apartments are the perfect opportunity for “newcomers” to Munich to quickly find their footing and build meaningful connections. Here, you’ll find not just a place to stay, but also a welcoming and vibrant community to be part of. Thanks to the relaxed and friendly atmosphere in our shared flats, settling in feels effortless. In our experience, everyone quickly finds their place—whether you’re new to the city or simply looking for a fresh start. We, as landlords, highly value respectful and considerate interactions among roommates—because a harmonious living environment is what truly makes shared living enjoyable!

Common Areas
The apartment was recently renovated and shines with a modern and fresh design. It features a stylish bathroom with high-quality, contemporary tiles that create a welcoming atmosphere. The built-in kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for cooking and dining: a refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, oven, sink, dishwasher, and washing machine. Many of our shared apartments even include washing machines with an integrated dryer function, adding extra convenience. There is also a comfortable dining area with seating for shared meals and socializing. The high-quality flooring throughout the apartment enhances the modern ambiance and provides a comfortable living environment. Wi-Fi is, of course, available – either provided by the landlord and included in the monthly utility costs or organized among the flatmates, with minimal shared costs. This combination of comfort, style, and modern amenities makes living in this apartment particularly enjoyable and ensures a smooth daily routine.

Neighborhood
The apartment is located in a peaceful area of Munich. The neighborhood offers excellent public transportation options, making it easy to explore the city and access various local amenities. It combines a tranquil residential environment with close proximity to Munich’s vibrant cultural and social scenes, making it an ideal choice for both students and professionals seeking comfort and convenience.

Please note: The keys can only be handed over and you can only move in if the deposit and the admin fee have been demonstrably transferred to the provider before the move-in date.

title: Wildmoosstraße, Starnberg
description:
Willkommen in dieser liebevoll eingerichteten und vollständig ausgestatteten 5 Zimmer-Wohnung .
